title: The project-existence check of the role commands also refused remove-project-role, so a role kept by the migration on a G2 project identifier could no longer be revoked while authorization still honoured it
resolution: Member commands and assign-project-role require an existing project; remove-project-role accepts any identifier. A PostgreSQL upgrade test keeps a role on g2-project through the migration, removes it, and checks the lost access and its audit event.

title: parseProjectName counted UTF-16 code units, so a name that DisplayText and char_length accept, such as 1024 supplementary characters, was refused on creation and rename
resolution: The name is counted in code points; module and HTTP tests create and rename a name of 1024 supplementary characters and refuse 1025.

title: The in-memory store kept the caller's defaults object and implementers array, so a later change of the input changed stored defaults without a revision, unlike PostgreSQL
resolution: add and replaceDefaults store a frozen copy of the defaults and their implementers; a shared conformance case changes the inputs after both writes and checks the stored values and revisions on both adapters.

title: The HTTP list test depended on projects that earlier tests created, and the file shared one store and clock across tests
resolution: Every test builds its own store, clock, server, and logins; the list test creates its second project and passes when selected alone, which the base test did not.

title: Only concurrent renames were covered; concurrent defaults changes, concurrent assignments, and an assignment against a removal, with their audit consistency, had no regression test
resolution: Conformance cases for concurrent defaults replacements, assignments, and a removal; module and PostgreSQL tests with transactions held until both have read: one winner with one audit event, and the role the last audit event leaves. Mutations make them fail.

title: The disclosure scenario's principal without a role on a project included an installation-owner, which reads a project and learns 404 for a missing one
resolution: The scenario names a principal that lacks the role the operation requires, and no installation-owner on a read.

title: Task 6.4 cited the retired governance rule Conditional third pass
resolution: Task 6.4 cites Review sequence: pass 3 runs when pass 2 reports a Medium-or-higher finding.
